items.label: API tokens on
items.description: Let members make API tokens and use them to call plugins from scripts.
items.long_description: When off, existing tokens stop working and new ones cannot be made. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Longest an API token lasts (days)
items.description: A token cannot be made to last longer than this; 0 allows tokens that never expire.
items.long_description: A token made without a length lasts 90 days (or this, if shorter). Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Requests per token per minute
items.description: More than this many requests in a minute with one token are refused.
items.long_description: 0 is no limit. The count is kept per server process. Organizations can override the global default.
